en.headline: CFS finds pre-packaged black cod exceeding methylmercury limit
en.dek: A sample of Alaska Seafood U.S. Alaska Black Cod Steak contained 0.8 mg/kg of methylmercury, above the legal limit of 0.5 mg/kg; the Centre for Food Safety ordered the affected batch withdrawn from sale and recalled.
body: The Centre for Food Safety announced on Thursday that a pre-packaged black cod sample had been found to contain methylmercury above the legal limit.

The product, Alaska Seafood U.S. Alaska Black Cod Steak (350 g packs from the United States, best before 20 September 2026), was sampled under the regular food surveillance programme from an online shop. Testing showed 0.8 mg of methylmercury per kilogram, exceeding the statutory maximum of 0.5 mg/kg.

The centre said it had instructed the vendor to stop selling and remove the affected batch. The importer, Galleon International Limited, is conducting a recall; members of the public can call 3643 0172 during office hours for details. The centre is tracing the product’s source and reminded consumers that high mercury intake can affect foetal brain development and, in adults, vision, hearing and coordination.

zh.headline: 食安中心檢銀鱈魚扒甲基汞超標 受影響批次須下架回收
zh.dek: 一個預先包裝美國銀鱈魚扒樣本甲基汞含量每公斤0.8毫克，超出法例上限0.5毫克；食安中心已指令停售下架，進口商正回收。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周四公布，一個預先包裝銀鱈魚扒樣本被檢出金屬雜質甲基汞含量超出法例標準。
涉事產品為Alaska Seafood的U.S. Alaska Black Cod Steak，每包350克，來源地美國，最佳食用日期為2026年9月20日，經銷商永利隆，進口商Galleon International Limited。中心透過恆常食物監測計劃從網上商店抽取樣本，結果顯示甲基汞含量為每公斤0.8毫克，超出法例上限每公斤0.5毫克。
中心已通知商戶將受影響批次停售及下架，進口商正按指示回收，市民可於辦公時間致電3643 0172查詢。中心正追查來源，並提醒攝取大量汞可能影響胎兒腦部發展，對成人則可能損害視力、聽覺及肌肉協調。
